notes.title: HOT New Update! v2.3 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/Update_2-3_Announcement.jpg[/IMG]

You may have noticed a jump in the ːTinyːinyːKːeep version numbers (the last being v1.5). Since then various incremental changes have been made over the last month or two but most of them were to test out functionality for the mobile versions. That said, check out and see what version 2.3 has in store for you!

[h1]Update v2.3[/h1]
[list]
   [*]You can now gain Double Fireproof if you have the Baby Dragon unlocked on New Game+. The second fireproof prevents you from being set on fire, so you're not even affected by slowdown.
   [*]The camera smoothing code has been rewritten and should now vary less across the different framerates and graphics set ups.
   [*]By popular demand, you can now choose to Restart Game or Exit To Main Menu upon dying.
   [*]General bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: TinyKeep OST! Update 1.5 is Alive!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/OST-Announcement.jpg[/IMG]

The full original soundtrack for TinyKeep, which is composed, orchestrated and mastered by Will Bedford, is now available for purchase!

[i]Album artwork by Phi Dinh.
Awful puns by Ben Jones.
Track 14 uses some in-game sounds by Jey Kazi.[/i]

1. TinyKeep
2. Saviour In The Dark
3. All Locked Up With Someplace To Go
4. Cobb and Twist
5. Pershdal Dungeons
6. A Bone Of Contention
7. Orcward Silences
8. The Party Shop
9. Sulphur So Good
10. An Alternate Dimension
11. The Final Choice
12. I Have A Bone To Pick With You
13. Credits
14. The Spinal Tap-Dance
15. Trailer (Bonus Track)

Grab all 15 amazing tracks here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/344530
[h1]Update v1.5:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Game automatically restarts on death instead of making the player go through the character creation and intro again.
   [*]Improved shrine messaging.
   [*]Baby dragon fire no longer damages player in New Game+ mode - player is automatically given the Fireproof buff when becoming the "Mother of Dragons"
   [*]Various physics and performance tweaks
[/list]

notes.notes:

Hear ye, hear ye all ːTinyːinyːKːeep fans and curious passersby! Locked deep within the keep are many ːTKskullː's, ːTKorcː's and other nasties out to kill you and keep you from their ːTKchestː. But alas, you have a friend that has journeyed ahead leaving you notes to help you along.

notes.title: MAC GAMERS EXPERIENCE THE THRILL OF ESCAPE
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/eBlast-Mac-Announcement.jpg[/img]

All the intense creature filled, randomly generated dungeons, ruins and hellscapes of TinyKeep have invaded the Mac systems of gamers the world over.  The intense indie crawler by Phigames is now available on Windows PC, MAC and Linux!

Mac gamers now can assume the role of the hopeless prisoner who must escape TinyKeep!   Players lure monsters into traps, knock over torches to set the dungeon alight and free prisoners to help them in their escape. There are many ways to survive the TinyKeep... and many ways to die in it.

notes.title: LINUX HAS BEEN INVADED BY TINYKEEP!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/TinyKeep-On-Linux.jpg[/img]

Linux gamers can now assume the role of a hopeless prisoner held deep in a forgotten dungeon - left to perish in the deepest, darkest cells of the keep. The nights pass by and all hope seems lost, you realize that the end is drawing near. But on one fateful day, you wake up and find yourself mysteriously free of your shackles, and in front of you lies a broken, unlocked door. There is only one thing left to do, you must now escape TinyKeep!

notes.title: TINYKEEP v1.2 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/TK_Update_1-2.jpg[/img]

Since launch, Phigames has been heavily involved in the forums and keeping an eye on the most requested features by the players. Version 1.2 brings with it a some major new additions as well as some tweaks and fixes that enhance the [i]TinyKeep[/i] experience.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Temporary Save and Quit
  [*]Unlockable Level Selects
  [*]Custom Control Remapping
  [*]25 New Achievements
  [*]Disable screen shake option
  [*]Disable Xbox360 controller prompts
[/list]
[h1]Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Lighter corpses
  [*]Coin collection radius increase
  [*]Improved/clearer Xbox360 controller diagram
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
  [*]A handful of level seeds were unwinnable as the player was too "fat" to fit in some of the gaps in the wall. This no longer happens
  [*]Fixed some unwinnable cave areas
  [*]Pause menu can now be closed with ESC
[/list]

Find out more [i]TinyKeep[/i] v1.2 details over on the developer's blog here: http://blog.tinykeep.com/2014/10/tinykeep-v12-is-here.html.
